The '''KW traffic controller'''<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy" /> was a model of [[Class three droid/Legends|Class 3]] [[Controller droid/Legends|spaceport control droid]]<ref name="Star Wars Sourcebook" /> manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. After the series was discontinued,<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy" /> their clamshell-shaped heads were appropriated<ref name="The Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> for the [[M-3PO military protocol droid]].<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy" />
